text: Make Parse a diamond. Color it yellow, then drop a box called Retry below it. Is Retry connected to Done? If it is not, hook Retry back to Parse with a dashed line, since that loop should look different from the main path.

Please move the card Review below Done, I think it is finished now. After that, make the Todo box green because it is a new sprint. Do we have any shape on the board that is not blue? Also change the label of Doing to In Progress, thank you for helping.

Connect Idle to Running with an arrow labeled start, since that is the only way out of the idle state. Make Stopped a hexagon and put it below Running. Can you tell me whether Stopped is reachable from Idle? Then draw a dotted connection from Running to Stopped labeled crash, so the failure path stands out.

Could you tell me how many boxes are in the plan right now? That helps me check the count before tomorrow's meeting.

Please insert a rectangle called Lint between Build and Test, since linting has to run before the tests start. Color Lint teal and then connect Test to Deploy so the release waits on the tests. Which shapes are not green right now? Thanks.

I'm making a mind map about the water cycle, so make Plants a diamond... no wait, make Plants a hexagon instead. Then duplicate Animals three times so each habitat has its own box. Is there anything blue on the map right now? Also color Water blue, because that's the theme.

Add a hexagon called Redis to the right of Cache, and make it cyan. Next, connect Api to Redis with a dotted line labeled reads. What is the degree of Db? Also, can you swap Lb and Api so the ingress sits in the right place.

Our class is making a food chain poster on the board, so please make the Grass green and the Rabbit brown. Then draw an arrow from Grass to Rabbit and another arrow from Rabbit to Fox. Since foxes hunt rabbits, can you move Fox to the right of Rabbit? Which shape is the leftmost one right now?

Could you please move the Bugs card above Sprint, since it's the most urgent item this week? I would be grateful if you could also recolour Shipped to gray. Is there a red shape on the board right now? Would you mind listing every square that sits to the right of Backlog?

I am making diagram for the app login flow. Please create a diamond called Check below Login and color it orange. After that, connect Check to Home with a label ok, and connect Check to Error with label fail. How many arrows goes out from Check now?

We need to sketch the ground floor plan for the new branch, so I'm going to shift the lift to the left of Stair. Please nudge Office 30 pixels up to give the corridor more room. Add a square called Storage between Lobby and Lift and make it small. Which boxes are closest to Lobby?

Let's add a step between Clean and Load that enriches the rows, so make a hexagon called Enrich and put it below Clean. Then connect Enrich to Load with a dashed arrow, and label it batch. Can you check how many steps the path from Ingest to Report passes through? Also, could you swap Clean and Load so the order is right.

Mark the Lair room as huge because it is the final boss area and needs to look bigger on screen. Recolor Hall to navy, then put a star called Chest between Gate and Lair. Keep the Gate where it is for now. Which is the rightmost shape right now?

Our HR team reshuffled the reporting lines, so please move Lead below Manager and make Intern's box small. Who reports directly to Director? Could you check whether Intern is still smaller than Lead? Then rename Lead to Supervisor because that is the official title now.

Please move Abuelo to the top of the page because he is the oldest one in the family. Make Padre blue and connect Padre to Hijo with a plain line, no arrow. Do you know who is directly linked to Hijo? Also, is Padre bigger than Abuelo?

Okay um so I'm sketching the dashboard and the sidebar should go to the left side of the canvas, so move Sidebar there. Make Card2 huge and then put a circle called Avatar near Card1. So which cards are gray right now? Also rename Header to TopBar please.

Hey! So this is my brainstorm board for the startup and I keep wanting to reorganize it. Could you put Money above Idea? Also make Time pink, because pink feels calm to me. What is the most connected shape on the board right now?
Swap Rack1 and Rack2 so the cooling units line up along the wall. Set Door to huge, then nudge Aisle 20 pixels to the left. How many squares are in the room right now? Thanks.

We have a QA gate between Stage and Sink, so please create a triangle called Gate and place it between them. Color Gate gold and label it validated. Connect Source to Gate with a dotted line because the data is still in flux. How many connections does Sink have right now?

Miss said we need the planets drawn around the Sun, so can you arrange everything in a circle? Make Earth blue, cause it's the only one with water. Who's the smallest one? Also, could you draw a dashed line from Sun to Mercury.

Please move Ruins to the right of Forest so the path from town feels natural. Make the Mountain a huge hexagon, and then recolor it to white if the snow looks better. What is the color of Town right now? Which shape is the largest on the map?

Our Kubernetes diagram needs a load balancer, so create a diamond called Lb above Ingress and make it navy. Connect Lb to Pod1 and Pod2 with solid arrows, then arrange Pod1 and Pod2 in a row. How many connections does Store have, and which shape is the rightmost one? Thanks for the help with this one.

Sorry but Launch is in the wrong spot again, so move it to the right of Build. Turn Idea into a pink square, I don't care what people think. Which items are still not finished, meaning shapes that are not green? Then recolor Build to green, if the code works now.

Connect Orders to Users with a bidirectional arrow, since both sides reference each other. Then add a square called Payments below Orders and label it stripe. Could you check whether Items is connected to Users directly? Thanks!

My picture of the garden has a tree and a sun, so please make the Sun yellow and make the Tree green. After that, put the Sun above the Tree. What is the color of the Sky now? Also tell me how many shapes are colored yellow.

Our new house layout is still rough, so move the Bath to the left of Bed. Could you make Kitchen a huge square? Then draw a plain line between Kitchen and Bath, no arrows, because they share a wall. How many rooms are there right now?

Uh so, okay, put Ops to the right of Sales please, and make Board a large triangle. Is Sales connected to Board right now? Also what is the biggest shape on the chart? No rush, but it would help to have it soon.

Pls add a diamond called Gate between Scan and Push. Make the gate orange and connect Build to Gate with a dashed arrow, then remove the arrow between Scan and Push. Is Gate connected to Push already? It has to look presentable for the workshop.

Okay so the new bus route needs to go from Central to Airport, so connect them with a dashed line that is labeled 42. Put Stadium between Harbor and Airport if there's space, then tell me the path from Central to Stadium. Also please recolor Harbor teal. I have a long list of other tasks today.
